Maintenance › Report
Roxgold SiteLife.
Reporting a maintenance issue.
An air conditioner that no longer cools.
A leak under the washbasin.
Reported by word of mouth, the problem is soon forgotten…
and nobody knows how the repair is going.
With Roxgold SiteLife, you report the incident
from your phone, in just a few taps.
It is then tracked until it is resolved.
From your home screen, tap the Report tab,
at the bottom of the screen.
The Maintenance page opens.
Tap the gold button with the plus sign.
The Report an incident form appears.
Start with a short title.
For example: Air conditioner not working.
Then describe the problem.
Choose the category, here Air conditioning,
then the priority: High.
Give the location: Accommodation for your room,
or Other facility.
Enter the residence,
then the block or room.
Add a photo if needed.
The handling deadline is set automatically
according to the priority.
Tap Report the incident.
Done. The incident appears in your list,
with the Reported status and its due date.
Tap it to see its journey: reported,
assigned, in progress, resolved, then closed.
The camp managers are notified
as soon as it is reported.
Every incident is recorded, prioritised and tracked,
until it is resolved.
Roxgold SiteLife.
One report, one follow-up.
